decisions.reason: Changing the fiat on-ramp provider to Transak does not alter fiat users' email-based access to dashboard commissions, tickets, or prizes.
The provider selection changes the fiat payment path, not the independently defined primary NFT mint behavior.
The Transak decision does not change Brevo as the transactional email provider or any email-delivery behavior.
Selecting Transak for fiat payments does not change SIWE authentication for crypto mint and transfer flows.
The fiat on-ramp provider choice does not affect secondary-sale royalties, prize-pool funding, or referral-ticket generation.
The source selects a fiat payment provider but does not change email or magic-link authentication for dashboard access.
The dashboard must still display referrals, tickets, and prizes regardless of which fiat on-ramp provider is used.
The Transak provider decision does not change unauthenticated access to public APIs or their exposed data.
The fiat payment provider has no necessary effect on badge eligibility or referral-based badge triggers.
Selecting Transak does not alter the approved achievement badge catalog.
The source changes only the fiat on-ramp provider and does not change the automatic $5 commission for code-based referrals.
The fiat provider selection does not change the requirement to deploy the smart-contract system on Base.
